title: fix(metadata-protocol): a form view's unknown field or group is answered on save and publish, and the group finding reaches the read
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VuKSPKLCdyPe1HVgMCJrsr)_
Fixes #29309

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图写了对象上不存在的字段或字段分组时，直接保存（非草稿）和发布的应答现在在 `advisories` 里带上 lint 原文警告（`form-field-unknown` / `form-section-group-unknown`）；读取的 `_diagnostics.warnings` 也补上了分组那一条。
- 为什么改：MCP / AI 作者只看保存与发布的应答，以前这两处一声不吭，只有之后再读一次才知道字段或整个分区被静默跳过。
- 风险与回滚：只加警告，不拒绝任何保存或发布，`valid` 不变；草稿保存照旧不跑规则。规则现在也读 Studio 存的表单项（`viewKind: 'form'`，分区在 `config` 下），所以 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 对这类表单也会多出同样的警告。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts`（表单项 `config` 这一级的遍历），`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（`validateFormLayout` 登记项改为 `runtimeTypes: ['view']`），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`（读取放行两条规则），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`，预期 10 个用例全绿；在 main 上新增的用例 4 个红（对照组绿）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Save and publish answers** (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`): the `validateFormLayout` registration moves from `CLI_ONLY` + `RUNTIME_NEEDS_FULL_SNAPSHOT` to `CLI_AND_RUNTIME` + `runtimeTypes: ['view']`.
- **The form item rung** (`packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts`, the view walk only, per claim amendment 6579089637): the rule also walks a `viewKind: 'form'` item's `config` sections, the shape Studio saves (`{ name, object, viewKind: 'form', config }`), binding `config.data.object` first and the item's `object` otherwise. Rule ids, messages, hints and severity are unchanged. A list item's `config` is not walked. The rung lives in this rule, not in the shared `view-walk.ts`, so the other walkers' verdicts do not move. The CLI commands see the same rung, so a stack carrying a form item is judged there too. The rule is advisory, so an active save and a publish of a view whose form names an unknown field or an undeclared field group land as before and answer both findings in `advisories` (rule id, message, hint, `severity: 'warning'`).
- **The read** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`): `withFormLayoutWarnings` lets `form-section-group-unknown` through beside `form-field-unknown`, with the lint's own message (one spelling). Its own `config` adapter (`formLayoutSubject`, from #29196) is retired: the rule now reads the served item as it is, the same walk the gate runs, and the read's paths (`config.sections.0.fields.1`) are unchanged.

### The measurement the card asked for (the snapshot at the real doors)

Read and then measured on a real showcase boot (`pnpm dev --fresh`, this branch's build):

| door | runs the registry? | objects in the snapshot | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PUT /meta/view/X` (active save) | yes | `registry.listItems('object')` = `getAllObjects` → `resolveObject` (overlay + every extender folded, the shape `getObject` serves), plus stored rows folded by `foldStoredCollection` | container form naming `loyalty_tier` (a `showcase_account` extension field), `no_such_field` and group `no_such_group`: two advisories, the extension field not reported |
| `POST /meta/view/X/publish` | yes | same | `no_such_field` answered as a warning, publish not refused |
| `PUT /meta/view/X?mode=draft` | no (#4463 D1: no rule gates a draft) | none handed to any rule | no advisory, by contract; the draft read carries the warnings (#29196) |
| runtime-authored object (stored row only) | yes | stored half | form on it: its real fields known, `nope_field` reported |
| control | yes | same | form naming `name` + `loyalty_tier`: no advisory |
| Studio form item, before the rung | yes | same | `PUT /meta/view/showcase_account.probe_e` (`viewKind: 'form'`, `no_such_field` under `config`): no advisory, the read warned. This is what the rung closes; pinned below. |

So the objects are present, extensions and stored rows included, on both doors that run rules. No door hands the rule a snapshot without them.

### No double report on the read

The read carries no runtime advisory: the draft read folds the publish verdict's refusals only (`withPublishVerdict`), and these findings are never refusals. Pinned: the active read after an active save carries each finding once.

## Tests

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts` (the #29196 file and harness, no new engine double), four new cases:

1. a section naming an undeclared field group reads with the lint warning, draft and active (half 2);
2. an active save naming an unknown field and an unknown group answers both as warnings with the lint's rule/message/hint, and the active read carries each once (half 1);
3. a draft save carries no advisory (D1), and its publish answers `form-field-unknown` as a warning and is not refused (half 1);
4. control: real fields (an extension field among them) and a declared group answer no advisory and read `{ valid: true }`;
5. a Studio form item naming an unknown field: an active save and a publish answer it as a warning, and its read carries it once at `config.sections.0.fields.1`;
6. control: a form item naming only real fields (an extension field among them) answers no advisory.

`packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.test.ts`, four new cases: a form item's unknown field and undeclared group, found at `views[0].config…` with `where` `· config`; the config's own `data.object` binding wins over the item's `object`; control: real fields and a declared group are clean; control: a list item's `config` is not walked.

Red first: cases 1-3 red on `origin/main` `57cde8cb` (control green); after the round-1 fix, case 5 and the two lint finding cases red on `9226d33b` (both controls green).

**Forced test edits**, named:
- `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`: the stub registry's `listItems('object')` now lists the served (merged) object rather than the authored one. Both real registry reads go through `resolveObject`; the old stub answered a shape no registry answers and would have invented a phantom on the extension field. The fixture object also declares one `fieldGroups` entry.
- `runtime-gate.test.ts` (three lists), `authoring-rule-wiring.test.ts` (one), `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts` (one): the `view` write's rule list gains `validateFormLayout` after `validateReferenceIntegrity`.

## Acceptance notes

- Advisory paths at the gate are stack-shaped (`views[0].formViews.edit.sections[0].fields[2]`, `views[0].config.sections[0].fields[1]`), as every runtime-gate advisory is; the read's warnings stay item-relative.
- A `?mode=draft` save runs no registry rule (#4463 D1), so it answers no form-layout advisory; its read and its publish do. Left as it is by the seat.
- An object outside the write's package closure is not in the snapshot; both checks skip an unknown object, so such a form is not judged rather than misjudged.
- Cost: no new read. The rule walks the objects the gate already gathers; the view read path loses an adapter and gains nothing.

## Verification

Head: `6266ec85` (merge of `origin/main` `7f277a86` into the rung commit `eb7ddbb4`). All runs below on `6266ec85` unless marked.

- Round 1 red first on `origin/main` `57cde8cb`: `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)` (cases 1-3; control green).
- Round 2 red first on `9226d33b` (new pins, rule unchanged): `validate-form-layout.test.ts` `Tests 2 failed | 34 passed (36)`, `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts` `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)` (case 5; both controls green).
- Green on `eb7ddbb4`: `36 passed (36)`, `10 passed (10)`.
- Ablation 1 (registration back to `CLI_ONLY`, lint rebuilt, preflight marker in 4 built files): cases 2 and 3 red; restored, preflight `--absent` exit 0.
- Ablation 2 (read filter back to `form-field-unknown` only): cases 1 and 2 red; restored.
- Ablation 3 (the `config` rung removed, lint rebuilt, preflight marker in 4 built files): lint `2 failed | 34 passed`; door `3 failed | 7 passed` (the #29196 read pin, case 1 and case 5: the read has no adapter now, so it depends on the rung too); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0.
- Real showcase boot measurements: see the table above.
